name: Ferdinand II
office: King of Bohemia; later Holy Roman Emperor
why_playable: Ferdinand sits at the point where dynastic survival, imperial law, Catholic restoration, estate liberties, allied dependence, and war finance collide.
player_wants: Secure Habsburg rule in Bohemia and the hereditary lands
Satisfy Catholic allies without making them too powerful
Prevent the revolt from becoming a wider European war
constraints: Need for Bavaria and the Catholic League
success_conditions: Imperial authority recovers without unbearable foreign intervention
failure_conditions: Estate trust collapses into wider resistance
Fiscal exhaustion and devastation make victory self-defeating
